newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Kelani Tyre up 20 pct on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Kelani Tyre up 20 pct on retail buying.

text.p: Shares in Kelani Tyre Ltd rose 20 percent or 1.50 rupees to nine rupees on retail buying in early Wednesday trade, brokers said.
"Small retail investors are chasing the share which is fairly liquid and also cheap," said a local broker.

Investor sentiment has improved since Sri Lankan companies are expected to see good growth in 1997 due to a better power situation compared with 1996 and low cost borrowings, after the Central Bank cut reserve ratios, brokers said.

"An agreement between the government and the opposition to work together to solve the northeast conflict, has also helped," said another broker, referring to the government's ethnic war with Tamil Tiger rebels.
